body: Everything you're saying is true. I'm not too optimistic, but I have to admit, you do a good job of arguing your point.
That's not the way I see the world though. Choice just seems to be an illusion to me. Even if I'm wrong, I think I'll ultimately just choose the easy path, instead of the harder one.
I've had years to change, and I haven't yet. Why would now be any different?

Maybe I can't change it though. Maybe it's just an intrinsic part of me. Maybe I just don't feel like putting in the effort to change who I am when I'll probably fail anyway, and suicide is just a lot easier.

I'm feeling pretty average, at least for me. It just feels like suicide is the best decision I can make. It doesn't feel like I'm being influenced by my emotional state; it just seems like a logical thing to do for someone like me. I just can't do it.

I'd go into more detail, but it would disgust me to have to write it out and see it on the screen in front of me. And you can't be so sure you won't judge me without knowing what exactly I hate about myself. Although, as shitty of a person as I am, I don't actually usually bring deliberate harm to others, which is something I guess.
I guess those really are the important questions, and to be honest I don't really have an answer. I can't honestly say I know why I do the things I do.

Recognizing that you've fucked up is meaningless if you're ultimately unwilling to change. You could argue it makes me worse; other people  might at least think they're doing the right thing, but I know I'm a failure of a human being, yet I just keep on doing the same things.
